articles.title: Air India CEO Gebremariam Gets Free Hand to Rebuild Senior Management
articles.excerpt: Tata Sons has backed the former Ethiopian Airlines chief to hire from outside the group and restructure Air India's top team, as a Rs 22,238 crore FY26 consolidated loss sharpens the turnaround pressure.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora flyers on India-North America and India-Europe routes, the test of the reset is reliability and cabin quality, not the org chart.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Airbnb Recreates K3G's Raichand House in Mumbai, Bookings Open November 23
articles.excerpt: For the film's 25th anniversary, Airbnb's free two-hour 'At Home with the Raichands' experience runs December 1–6 in Mumbai with 180 invitations — the grand staircase, the family study and Poo's closet, rebuilt for fans.
articles.image_caption: The recreated Raichand House in Mumbai, with its grand double staircase, built by Airbnb for the 25th anniversary of Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham. The free two-hour experience runs December 1-6, 2026, with booking requests opening November 23.
articles.nri_angle: A free, bookable piece of Bollywood nostalgia in Mumbai this December — requests open November 23, timed for diaspora fans planning a winter trip home.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

dates.event: Booking requests open at 12 p.m. IST

articles.title: Air India Restores Non-Stop Flights to New York, Cutting Travel Time by Five Hours
articles.excerpt: All four routes — Delhi and Mumbai to JFK and Newark — are non-stop again after the Rome refuelling stop was dropped, with journeys down from around 22 hours to approximately 17.
articles.image_caption: An Air India Airbus A350-900 in the airline's new livery on the tarmac. Air India has restored non-stop services from Delhi and Mumbai to New York, cutting journey times by up to five hours.
articles.nri_angle: For US-based diaspora travellers, the India-New York journey drops by up to five hours with the Rome stop gone, on daily JFK services and near-daily Newark services.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Air India Says US Flights Ran On Schedule Despite Ground Stop
articles.excerpt: In a Saturday-evening update reversing its earlier delay warning, Air India said its New York, Newark and San Francisco flights landed and departed on time — with one documented exception, a San Francisco departure more than three hours late.

sources.label: Business Standard (syndicated report via The S Bharat)

articles.nri_angle: Air India's nonstop U.S.–India services are the diaspora's main direct link home; the airline's confirmation that New York, Newark and San Francisco flights ran on time means most India-bound travellers face connection risk, not a cancelled long-haul flight.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Tourism Boom Is Real — and Lopsided: 4.29 Billion Domestic Visits, but Growth Concentrated in a Few Markets
articles.excerpt: Domestic tourist visits jumped 45.6% to about 4.29 billion in 2025, yet hotel occupancy runs at 75% in tier-one cities against 57% in tier-three markets, and a 161,000-room pipeline is betting on closing that gap.
articles.image_caption: The Taj Mahal in Agra, one of India's most visited tourist sites.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora travellers, the numbers explain the split experience of India trips: polished capacity in the big metros, thinner hotel supply in the smaller cities family visits actually go to.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Weekly Train to Link Nepal's Janakpur Dham With Ayodhya Over 604 Kilometres
articles.excerpt: The government has announced a weekly service between Janakpur Dham and Ayodhya Cantt, departing Janakpur on Saturdays and Ayodhya on Mondays, with stops across Bihar and Uttar Pradesh.
articles.image_caption: Janaki Mandir in Janakpur, Nepal, photographed in August 2017. Archival photograph.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora pilgrims planning a Ramayana Circuit trip, the train links Sita's birthplace and Ram's birthplace in one weekly cross-border journey.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.nri_angle: Indian and diaspora SUV buyers tracking the Fortuner's next update get an early look at its design direction, with an India launch expected in 2027 but not yet confirmed by Toyota.
